bullets.text: Zoom Opens UK Data Centre - **Zoom** plans a UK data centre by 2026 to enhance local data residency and AI services.
VMO2 Negotiates £2bn Acquisition - **Virgin Media O2** is in talks to acquire **Netomnia**, marking a significant UK fibre market consolidation.
Equinix Invests £3.9bn in Data Centre - **Equinix** plans a £3.9 billion data centre in Hertfordshire, boosting UK digital infrastructure.
O2 Partners with Starlink - **O2** collaborates with **Starlink** to enhance connectivity for remote assets in rural areas.
Jamf Launches AI Forensics Tool - **Jamf** introduces AI analysis to enhance mobile forensics and threat detection capabilities.
AI and 5G Convergence - **Nvidia** invests in **Nokia** to enhance AI capabilities in future 5G and 6G networks.
Changing Video Habits Create Data Challenges - UK viewers now prefer apps over traditional TV, complicating data management.
AI Infrastructure Bottleneck - **SK Telecom** addresses the growing demands of AI with new data centre strategies.
AI Strategy as Industrial Race - The competition for AI dominance is shifting towards deployment speed and efficiency.
